mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sender_id = #{memberId} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSendAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{memberId} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalReceiveAmount FROM settlements WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND (sender_id = #{memberId} OR receiver_id = #{memberId})
